claim: Have an ordinary spoken exchange with a nearby NPC through the configured local Gemma runner. Discover who heard the sentence, whether a real model request and reply occurred, and any visible consequence of an ordinary follow or stay instruction. Use actor-bound inspection and exact logs when needed. This qualifies harness access and observability, not model quality or all CAOL dialogue behavior.
material_proof: Cite submitted text, actor identities, actual routing/request/reply evidence, orders before and after, contradictions and cleanup. Separate retained fixture messages from new run events and model replies from deterministic command handling. Setup and diagnostic observations earn zero feature credit.
current_uncertainty: Can Luna operate and observe the real local NPC LLM integration without guessing who heard or what happened?
forbidden_shortcuts: raw physical input or parent-surface fallback
synthetic replies or fixture messages treated as new model output
honest_stop_conditions: useful outcomes or concrete reusable capability gaps established
